title: Margin — Growth & Users
description: Signups, activation, active users, workspaces and revenue, straight from margindb. Times are UTC as stored by the server.

panels.title: Total users
panels.description: Accounts that have not been soft-deleted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Total users" FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT count(*) AS "New users" FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT count(*) AS "Today" FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))

SELECT count(*) AS "Last 7 days" FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '7 days'

SELECT count(*) AS "Last 30 days" FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '30 days'
SELECT count(*) AS "Deleted" FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Daily active (24h)
panels.description: last_seen_at is stamped when a client opens the WebSocket, so this counts users who connected, not users who sent anything.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "DAU" FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at >= now() - interval '1 day'

panels.title: Weekly active (7d)
panels.description: last_seen_at is stamped when a client opens the WebSocket, so this counts users who connected, not users who sent anything.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "WAU" FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Monthly active (30d)
panels.description: last_seen_at is stamped when a client opens the WebSocket, so this counts users who connected, not users who sent anything.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "MAU" FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at >= now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU/MAU)
panels.description: Share of monthly actives who were active today. 20%+ is healthy for a chat app.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '1 day')
             / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '30 days'), 0), 1)
       AS "Stickiness"
FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

panels.title: Never connected
panels.description: Signed up but never opened a client. Includes accounts created before last_seen_at was added.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Never connected" FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at IS NULL

panels.title: Cohort still active
panels.description: Of the users who signed up inside the selected range, the share seen in the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '7 days')
             / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Still active"
FROM users
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0),
       count(*) AS "Signups"
FROM users WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(deleted_at, $__interval, 0),
       count(*) AS "Deletions"
FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(deleted_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total users (cumulative, all time)
panels.description: Deliberately ignores the time picker -- a cumulative line is only meaningful from the first signup onward. Zoom with the panel's own time range if needed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS "time", sum(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS "Total users"
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, count(*) AS new_users
  FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1
) d ORDER BY day

panels.title: Activation rate (range)
panels.description: Share of users who signed up in the range and confirmed their e-mail.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE ak.activated_at IS NOT NULL)
             / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Activation rate"
FROM users u LEFT JOIN activation_keys ak ON ak.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(u.created_at)

panels.title: Awaiting activation
panels.description: All-time. A large number here usually means e-mail delivery is failing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Awaiting activation"
FROM users u JOIN activation_keys ak ON ak.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND ak.activated_at IS NULL

SELECT round(CAST(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
         ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (ak.activated_at - ak.created_at)) / 3600.0
       ) AS numeric), 2) AS "Median hours"
FROM activation_keys ak
WHERE ak.activated_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ak.created_at)

panels.title: No activation record
panels.description: Users predating the activation_keys table. They are excluded from the activation rate above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "No activation record"
FROM users u LEFT JOIN activation_keys ak ON ak.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND ak.id IS NULL

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Signups"
FROM users WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(activated_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Activations"
FROM activation_keys
WHERE activated_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(activated_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Workspaces
panels.description: Margins that have not been soft-deleted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Workspaces" FROM margins WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

panels.title: New workspaces (range)
panels.description: created_at was added in April 2026; workspaces older than that have no timestamp and never appear here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "New" FROM margins
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT round(CAST(avg(members) AS numeric), 1) AS "Avg members"
FROM (
  SELECT m.margin_id, count(mm.user_id) AS members
  FROM margins m LEFT JOIN margin_members mm ON mm.margin_id = m.margin_id
  WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY m.margin_id
) t
SELECT count(*) AS "Active" FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT count(*) AS "Paid" FROM subscriptions
WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND tier <> 'FREE'

panels.title: MRR
panels.description: Prices are hard-coded from subscriptions.tiers in application.yml (SMALL 9.99, MEDIUM 29.99). Update this query if pricing changes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(CASE tier WHEN 'SMALL' THEN 9.99 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 29.99 ELSE 0 END)
       AS "MRR"
FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), count(*) AS "Workspaces"
FROM margins WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT tier AS "Tier", count(*) AS "Workspaces"
FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY tier ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT m.name AS "Workspace",
       count(mm.user_id) AS "Members",
       m.created_at AS "Created"
FROM margins m LEFT JOIN margin_members mm ON mm.margin_id = m.margin_id
WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY m.margin_id, m.name, m.created_at
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Invites by status (range)
panels.description: Invite acceptance is the main organic growth loop -- a rising PENDING share means invited people are not converting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Invites"
FROM margin_invites WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Trials and renewals due in 14 days

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.name AS "Workspace",
       s.tier AS "Tier",
       s.status AS "Status",
       s.trial_ends_at AS "Trial ends",
       s.current_period_end AS "Renews"
FROM subscriptions s JOIN margins m ON m.margin_id = s.margins
WHERE coalesce(s.trial_ends_at, s.current_period_end)
      BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + interval '14 days'
ORDER BY coalesce(s.trial_ends_at, s.current_period_end)
LIMIT 50
